photo.summary: This image shows a close-up view of the rear side of a silver car, focusing on the area around the fuel tank cap and the rear wheel. The car has a noticeable dent on the rear quarter panel, suggesting it has been involved in a minor collision. The fuel tank cap is circular and located on the top left of the car's rear. The rear wheel is partially visible, showing a silver alloy wheel with multiple spokes and a black tire. The car's exhaust pipe is also visible at the bottom right of the image. The background appears to be a tiled floor, possibly indicating that the car is in a garage or repair shop.
